pages.text: When a crop loses water (the source ran out, or the field is not served by any source), it $(bold)stops growing$() and starts a $(info)thirst timer$().$(br2)After $(thing)dryWitherDays$() (default 1) MC days without water, the crop $(warn)withers away$() and the farmland reverts to dirt.

pages.title: Restoring water
pages.text: Watering the field again - by pouring a source or by rain - $(bold)resets the thirst timer$().$(br2)Note: watering does $(warn)not$() save an over-mature crop. Over-maturity and thirst are separate death timers.
